justification: The may-apply box now shows a thumbnail of the plan's own map for 13 places (15 images rendered from the chapter PDFs, checked by eye; 7 wrong pages rejected), uploaded to R2 may-apply-maps/. Places without a clear figure keep the link only.

falsifiable_check.command: cd frontend-nextjs && npx jest __tests__/components/compliance/DcpMayApplyBlock.test.tsx; python -m pytest -q tests/test_may_apply_areas_drift.py
falsifiable_check.fails_when: A thumbnail shows without a url, the alt text is missing, or the export emits urls when the base url is empty.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: Images cropped from the council PDFs; public R2 url returns 200 image/png.

pre_impl.existing_data: Same R2 bucket and boto3 pattern as add_new_chapter.py.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Page search is a heuristic; 7 of 22 found pages were wrong (cover pages, diagrams) and were removed on review.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Render + upload scripts, image field in the export, thumbnail in the existing block.

functions.name: DcpMayApplyBlock
functions.input: may-apply areas with an optional map_image_url
functions.output: a lazy thumbnail linking to the plan page when the url exists
functions.if_none: no image url means the link alone is shown

values.value: 15 images kept of 22 rendered; 13 current places carry a url

break_it.scenario: A wrong page is shown as the area's map.
break_it.what_happens: The user reads the wrong drawing as the area.
break_it.how: All 22 checked by eye on one contact sheet; 7 removed.

break_it.what_happens: A broken image in the box.
break_it.how: Lazy image with alt text; the PDF link still works.
break_it.repro: block an image url in the browser

break_it.scenario: The image base address is left empty.
break_it.what_happens: No place in the box would show a thumbnail.
break_it.how: Export emits urls only when set; drift test covers both.

mutation_analysis: Removing the url check in the block fails the jest thumbnail test.

post_merge.manual_verify: Open a Pymble or Riverwood-area address: the box shows the map thumbnail.

residual_risk: 32 places still link only (no clear figure found).

real_layer_exempt.scripts/render_may_apply_maps.py: one-off offline tool: SELECT of chapter PDF urls + curl; its output (22 PNGs) was checked by eye on a contact sheet and 7 rejected; not on any served path
real_layer_exempt.scripts/upload_may_apply_maps.py: one-off upload tool run once with --commit on the user's approval; result verified by a public GET (200 image/png)
